title: Quiet Life
description: A mod focusing on nature to enjoy the slow Quiet Life.
body:
_There's so many different flowers in the world. Why stop at just a handful?_

 

**FEATURES:**

30+ new flowers to discover, collect, and display in this mod!\
Vegetation in this mod include:\
    Plains with Wild Blueberries\
    Jungles with Corpse Flowers and Titan Lilies\
    Stone Biomes with Dusty Millers\
    Deserts full of Ball Cacti



Why stop at just flowers?\
Other features include:\
Beaches with Sand Dollars and Clam Shells\
Badlands with Geysers and Large Dead Bushes

_There are a lot of more features to discover so go out and explore!_
